data.sections.attack.canAttack.descripti: If set to false, can not attack any unit. Overrides other canAttack options altogether. (繁体)
data.sections.attack.canAttackFlyingUnit: can also be narrowed per turret. Note: not required if canAttack is false. (繁体)
can also be narrowed per turret in [turret_NAME] (繁体)
data.sections.attack.canAttackUnderwater: can also be narrowed per turret in [turret_NAME] (繁体)
data.sections.attack.canAttackNotTouchin: Can Attack Not Touching Water Units (繁体)
Default true. If false unit can only attack units in contact with the water. Used for units with torpedos. (can also be set per turret) (繁体)
data.sections.attack.shootDelay.descript: Global delay, can also use delay on each turret. Set in seconds or ticks (繁体)

Will only attack units that has the specified tags. (繁体)

data.sections.attack.turretMultiTargetin: Allow each turrets to fire at a different target at the same time. Very useful if [turret]limitingAngle is used (繁体)
data.sections.attack.isMelee.description: Used with a low attack range (like maxAttackRange: 9) makes src and target radius get added to range, and effects AI. (繁体)
data.sections.attack.meleeEngangementDis: Makes unit move to attack nearby units. Defaults to 250 for melee, and 0 for non melee (Works even if non-melee, but might be unexpected to players) (繁体)
data.sections.attack.turretRotateWithBod: Are all turrets rotated when body rotates. Defaults to true (繁体)
data.sections.attack.attackMovement.desc: normal/bomber. bomber attack movement will retreat when energy runs out (繁体)
data.sections.attack.dieOnAttack.descrip: Will die when it attacks. (繁体)
data.sections.attack.isFixedFiring.descr: Must aim body at target to shoot. Will often make the unit need to stop before it can aim and shoot. (繁体)
data.sections.attack.aimOffsetSpread.des: Offset each shot multiplied by target radius. Defaults to 0.6. aimOffsetSpread:0 will make unit always attack center (繁体)
data.sections.attack.stopTargetingAfterF: Unit stops targeting after firing a shot. Rarely used or needed. (繁体)
data.sections.attack.disablePassiveTarge: Unit only attacks manually ordered target. Rarely used or needed. (繁体)
data.sections.attack.showRangeUIGuide.de: Will it show the range indicator. Useful for showing ranges in radar and related structures. (繁体)
data.sections.attack.shootDelayMultiplie: Defaults to 1. Can be dynamically changed with setUnitStats (繁体)
data.sections.attack.shootDamageMultipli: Defaults to 1. Can be dynamically changed with setUnitStats (繁体)
